title: How to Install Claude Code (Beginner Terminal Guide)
description:
Everybody is talking about installing Claude Code, but nobody wants to touch the terminal. Here is how you do it step-by-step. Go to your browser, type in "Claude Code install," and copy the URL. Open your terminal—on Mac, VS Code, or Antigravity—and paste it in.  

Type "Claude" to authenticate (you must have at least a $20 plan), and it functions just like a normal chat interface. You can have it build a landing page for roofers or even connect an Obsidian vault and thousands of skills to handle your specific workflows.  

Here's the Claude skills library I use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/10bKDjITaPcROcWhYJC9CgclGSj6dftak2KpmUnPGKNQ/edit?usp=sharing

#ClaudeCode #SoftwareEngineering #TechTips #Coding #WebDevelopment #AI #Terminal
